boundary: These contracts replay bounded structural, invariant, doctrine/source, regression, authority-adjacent, and exact-source-candidate evidence for admitted exemplars. Release evidence is admitted only when the replay is bound to a clean exact source revision; it is not package-publication or deployment evidence and does not establish any claim outside the named surfaces.

contracts.claim_scope: Typed chart, house, planet-position, and sky-position reduction vessels retain their tested response contracts.
exclusions: No external-authority numerical residual is inferred from transport tests.
The receipt does not promote regression coverage to an external astronomical authority comparison.
